title: Characterization of Valid Circuit Pairs
statement: For every bit string $x$, the pair test on $x$ returns true if and only if there are a natural number $n$ and two arithmetic circuits with $n$ input variables such that the total first and second projections of $x$ decode, respectively, to these circuits, and both circuits are nonempty and every gate that refers to earlier gates refers only to gates with smaller indices.
